source: Many decisions are thought to arise via the accumulation of noisy evidence to a threshold or bound. In perception, the mechanism explains the effect of stimulus strength, characterized by signal-to-noise ratio, on decision speed, accuracy and confidence.
reference: 许多决策被认为是在带噪声的证据不断积累、达到阈值或边界时形成的。在知觉过程中，这一机制解释了以信噪比表征的刺激强度如何影响决策速度、准确性和信心。

source: Many of our decisions are made on the basis of imperfect or ‘noisy’ information. A longstanding goal in neuroscience is to work out how such noise affects three aspects of decision-making: the accuracy (or appropriateness) of a choice, the speed at which the choice is made, and the decision-maker’s confidence that they have chosen correctly.
reference: 许多决策依据的信息都不完美，或称带有“噪声”。神经科学长期关注这类噪声如何影响决策的三个方面，即选择的准确性（或恰当性）、做出选择的速度，以及决策者对自己选对了的信心。

source: After each trial, the humans rated their confidence in their decision. By comparison, the monkeys could indicate that they were not confident in a decision by opting for a guaranteed small reward on certain trials (instead of the larger reward they received when they correctly indicated the direction of motion of the dots).
reference: 每次试验后，人类参与者都会评价自己对这次决策的信心。相比之下，猴子可在某些试次选择有保证的小额奖励，以表示对决定没有把握；若正确指出圆点运动方向，它们原本可得到更大的奖励。

source: In both humans and monkeys, increasing the noisiness associated with the movement of the dots led to faster and more confident decision-making, just as the bounded evidence accumulation framework predicts.
reference: 不论人还是猴子，与圆点运动有关的噪声增加时，决策都更快，也更有信心，正如有界证据累积框架所预测的那样。

source: Decisions that combine information from different sources or across time are of special interest to neuroscience because they serve as a model of cognitive function. These decisions are not hard wired or reflexive, yet they are experimentally tractable.

facts.zh: 既不是先天固化的反应，也不是反射

reference: 整合不同来源或不同时刻信息的决策可作为认知功能的模型，因此尤其受到神经科学的关注。这类决策既不是先天固化的反应，也不是反射，却可以通过实验加以研究。

source: If the bounded accumulation of noisy evidence underlies choice accuracy, RT and confidence, then a selective manipulation of the noise should produce quantitatively consistent effects on all three measures.
reference: 如果带噪声证据的有界累积是选择准确性、反应时（RT）和信心形成的基础，那么有选择地改变噪声应当对这三项指标产生定量上一致的影响。

source:
Specifically, were it possible to leave unchanged the expectation of each sample of
momentary evidence while boosting the noise associated with it, then the bounded accumulation of
the noisier samples should lead to (i) lower accuracy when the expectation of the momentary evi-
dence is strong, (ii) faster reaction times when the momentary evidence is weak, and (iii) increased
confidence when the momentary evidence is weak.
reference: 具体来说，如果能够在保持每次瞬时证据采样期望值不变的同时增大其噪声，那么对这些高噪声样本进行有界累积应有三种结果：（i）瞬时证据的期望值较强时，准确性降低；（ii）瞬时证据较弱时，反应时间缩短；（iii）瞬时证据较弱时，信心增强。

source:
We therefore sought a method to manipulate the variance associated with the neural representa-
tion of momentary evidence without affecting its mean. We achieved this with a manipulation of the
motion information in a random dot motion (RDM) display, by adding a second level of randomness
which increased its volatility but was unbiased with respect to the strength and direction of motion
evidence.

facts.zh: 未使运动证据的强度或方向产生系统偏差

reference: 因此，我们希望找到一种方法，在不影响均值的前提下改变瞬时证据神经表征的方差。为此，我们改变随机点运动（RDM）显示中的运动信息，加入第二层随机性，增大其波动性，但未使运动证据的强度或方向产生系统偏差。

source: Low and high volatility conditions are indicated by blue and red, respectively, in all panels.
reference: 所有分图中，蓝色和红色分别表示低波动性和高波动性条件。

source: Left: the coherence parameter is 0.128 for both stimuli, but in the high volatility condition this is the mean of a Gaussian distribution (S.D. = 0.256) that is sampled on every video frame (75 Hz).

facts.zh: 两种刺激的一致性参数均为 0.128

reference: 左图中，两种刺激的一致性参数均为 0.128。但在高波动性条件下，0.128 是高斯分布的均值，该分布的标准差为 0.256，每一视频帧均从中采样，帧率为 75 Hz。

source: Variance of the momentary evidence from model fits.
reference: 由模型拟合得到的瞬时证据方差。

source: In addition to the estimate of variance from neural recordings, we used a 3-parameter characterization of the noise as a function of volatility and motion strength. The example is from the fit to behavioral data from monkey W in the reaction-time task.
reference: 除根据神经记录估计方差外，我们还用三个参数描述噪声如何随波动性和运动强度变化。图中的例子取自对猴 W 在反应时任务中的行为数据所作的拟合。

source: For illustration purposes, before showing the moving dots we indicate the coherence, volatility and direction of motion. These were not displayed to the participants in the experiment.
reference: 为便于说明，在显示运动圆点之前，我们先标出运动的一致性、波动性及方向。实验时参与者并未看到这些提示。

source: A more systematic analysis of the motion energy, displayed in Figure 2B, reveals that the mean is identical for low and high volatility stimuli, for all motion strengths (upper panel), whereas the variance is larger for the high volatility stimuli (lower panel).

facts.source: variance is larger for the high volatility stimuli
facts.zh: 高波动性刺激的方差较大

reference: 图 2B 对运动能量的系统分析表明，在所有运动强度下，低波动性刺激与高波动性刺激的平均运动能量相同（上图），而高波动性刺激的方差较大（下图）。

source: The influence of volatility was evaluated with a likelihood-ratio test comparing models with and without the β2 term.

facts.source: with and without the β2 term
facts.zh: 含 β2 项与不含 β2 项

reference: 通过似然比检验比较含 β2 项与不含 β2 项的模型，以评估波动性的影响。

source:
The aim of this study was to investigate the association between physical activity
(PA), problematic smartphone use (PSU), and burnout, as well as to identify whether
there is a mediating role for PSU.

facts.zh: 考察身体活动（PA）、问题性智能手机使用（PSU）与倦怠之间的关联

facts.source: whether there is a mediating role for PSU
facts.zh: PSU 是否发挥中介作用

reference: 本研究旨在考察身体活动（PA）、问题性智能手机使用（PSU）与倦怠之间的关联，并确定 PSU 是否发挥中介作用。

source:
We recruited 823 college students ( Mage = 18.55,
SD = 0.83) from Wuhan, China, in December 2022, including 499 males and 324
females. Demographic information, the International Physical Activity
Questionnaire-Short Form (IPAQ-SF), the Smartphone Addiction Scale-Short
Version (SAS-SV), and the Maslach Burnout Inventory-Student Survey (MBI-SS)
were used for assessments.

facts.zh: 男性 499 人，女性 324 人

reference: 我们于 2022 年 12 月在中国武汉招募了 823 名大学生，平均年龄为 18.55 岁，标准差为 0.83。其中男性 499 人，女性 324 人。评估使用了人口学资料、国际身体活动问卷短表（IPAQ-SF）、智能手机成瘾量表简版（SAS-SV）和马斯拉赫倦怠量表学生版（MBI-SS）。

source: Physical activity is any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure (Bull et al., 2020).
reference: 身体活动是指由骨骼肌产生、需要消耗能量的任何身体运动（Bull 等，2020 年）。

source: Hypothesis 1: There will be a negative correlation between PA and burnout.
reference: 假设 1：身体活动（PA）与倦怠呈负相关。

source: Using the stratified cluster random sampling technique, we distinguished eight mutually independent strata based on differences in faculties, and then natural classes were used as clusters. A sample of three classes from each of the eight different faculties was randomly taken, and a total of 24 classes were invited to participate in the survey.

facts.zh: 每个院系随机抽取三个班

reference: 我们采用分层整群随机抽样，按院系划分八个相互独立的层，以自然班为群。每个院系随机抽取三个班，共邀请 24 个班参加调查。

source: This study employed a cross-sectional design in which participant demographic information, IPAQ-SF, SAS-SV, and MBI-SS measures were collected at a single point in time.

facts.source: at a single point in time

reference: 本研究采用横断面设计，在同一时间点收集参与者的人口学资料以及 IPAQ-SF、SAS-SV 和 MBI-SS 的测量数据。

source: Gender, age, educational qualification, type of household residence, annual family income, and “only child or not” were among the demographic data sought.
reference: 收集的人口学资料包括性别、年龄、学历、家庭居住类型、家庭年收入以及是否为独生子女。

source: We found that 318 (38.6%) students reached the moderate level and 379 (46.1%) students reached the high level. A total of 241 (48.3%) male and 134 (41.4%) female students had problems with smartphone use, respectively.
reference: 达到中等水平的学生有 318 人（38.6%），达到高水平的有 379 人（46.1%）。存在智能手机使用问题的男生和女生分别有 241 人（48.3%）和 134 人（41.4%）。

source: The results of the correlation analysis in Table 3 showed that PA was significantly negatively associated with PSU (r = −0.151, p < 0.001), PSU was significantly positively associated with burnout (r = 0.421, p < 0.001), while the negative association between PA and burnout was not statistically significant (r = −0.046, p > 0.05).

facts.zh: 与 PSU 呈显著负相关

reference: 表 3 的相关分析显示，PA 与 PSU 呈显著负相关（r = −0.151，P < 0.001），PSU 与倦怠呈显著正相关（r = 0.421，P < 0.001），而 PA 与倦怠的负相关无统计学意义（r = −0.046，P > 0.05）。

source: Similarly, PA did not have statistically significant associations with EX and PE (all p > 0.05) on any of the three dimensions of burnout.

facts.source: did not have statistically significant associations

reference: 同样，在倦怠的三个维度中，PA 与 EX 和 PE 的关联均无统计学意义（P 均 > 0.05）。

source: Notes: *p < 0.05, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001. Regression coefficients were standardized. The parameters of the control variable (i.e., gender) were not shown in the model.
reference: 注：*P < 0.05，**P < 0.01，***P < 0.001。回归系数均已标准化。模型图中未显示控制变量（即性别）的参数。

source: With respect to gender (male = 1, female = 0), we found that it did not significantly predict PSU (β = 0.101, p > 0.05, 95% CI [−0.041 to 0.242]).
reference: 关于性别（男 = 1，女 = 0），我们发现它对 PSU 没有显著预测作用（β = 0.101，P > 0.05，95% CI 为 −0.041 至 0.242）。

source: Number of bootstrap samples for percentile bootstrap confidence intervals: 5,000.

terms.zh: 百分位自助法置信区间
alternatives: 百分位数自助法置信区间

reference: 用于计算百分位自助法置信区间的自助重抽样次数为 5,000。

source: Recall and social-desirability bias may impact the collection of relevant data. The cross-sectional design of the current study did not provide strong corroboration for inferences of causality, and there may be potential bidirectional effects between variables.

facts.zh: 难以为因果推断提供有力佐证

reference: 回忆偏倚和社会期许偏倚可能影响相关数据的收集。本研究采用横断面设计，难以为因果推断提供有力佐证，变量之间可能存在双向影响。

source: Raw data to support the results of the data analysis, including all categorical and continuous variables for the 823 samples.

facts.zh: 所有分类变量和连续变量

reference: 支持数据分析结果的原始数据，包括 823 个样本的所有分类变量和连续变量。

source:
HPLC data
demonstrated that hesperidin was the most abundant ﬂavonoid in all peel extracts except for orange
peels, in which naringin was the predominant ﬂavonoid.

facts.zh: 橙皮中占主导的是柚皮苷

reference: HPLC 数据表明，除了橙皮以外，各种果皮提取物中含量最高的黄酮都是橙皮苷，而橙皮中占主导的是柚皮苷。

source: The purpose of this study was to characterize the beneficial phenolic molecules present in citrus fruit peels, which are widespread in the Mediterranean area. Additionally, the study aimed to quantify their antioxidant and free radical scavenging abilities.
reference: 本研究旨在表征地中海地区常见柑橘类水果果皮中有益的酚类分子，并定量评价其抗氧化和清除自由基的能力。

source: Naringin, rutin, apigenin and hesperidin pure standard solutions were analyzed with the UV-Vis spectrophotometer before and after performing the nitrite-aluminum colorimetric assay.
reference: 分别在进行亚硝酸盐–铝比色测定前后，用紫外–可见分光光度计分析柚皮苷、芦丁、芹菜素和橙皮苷的纯标准溶液。

source:
UV-Visible spectrophotometric analyses of pure ﬂavonoid standard solutions (rutin, nar-
ingin, apigenin and hesperidin, respectively, for panels (A–D)) with wavelengths between 200 nm 
and 600 nm. Panel (E) is the analysis of a mixture obtained with all standard molecules previously 
listed in weight ratio 1:1:1:1.
reference: 在 200 nm 至 600 nm 波长范围内，对纯黄酮标准溶液进行了紫外–可见分光光度分析。图 A 至 D 依次为芦丁、柚皮苷、芹菜素和橙皮苷。图 E 为将上述四种标准品按 1:1:1:1 质量比配制成的混合物的分析结果。

source: In detail, rutin stock solutions had a maximum absorbance (AbsMAX) value at λ~360 nm (Figure 1A); apigenin stock solutions had their AbsMAX value at λ~340 nm (Figure 1C); naringin and hesperidin stock solutions showed similar spectra with AbsMAX values at λ~330 nm (Figure 1B,D).
reference: 具体而言，芦丁储备液在 λ 约 360 nm 处达到最大吸光度（AbsMAX，图 1A），芹菜素储备液在 λ 约 340 nm 处达到最大吸光度（图 1C）。柚皮苷和橙皮苷储备液的光谱相似，最大吸光度均出现在 λ 约 330 nm 处（图 1B、D）。

source: Interestingly, all solutions presented a slight yellow color, except for rutin solutions which shifted to a reddish color as a function of the molecule concentration (Figure 2).
reference: 有趣的是，除芦丁溶液外，其余溶液均呈淡黄色。芦丁溶液则随分子浓度变化而转为偏红色（图 2）。

source: In particular, the nitrite-aluminum assay of the rutin solution was the only sample with a characteristic red–purple color variation, justifying its plausible quantification at λ = 510 nm. Apigenin solution shifted to a dark yellow, while naringin and hesperidin retained a light yellow color.
reference: 在亚硝酸盐–铝测定中，只有芦丁溶液呈现特征性的红紫色变化，因此可能适合在 λ = 510 nm 处定量。芹菜素溶液变为深黄色，而柚皮苷和橙皮苷溶液仍呈淡黄色。

source: Rutin, naringin, hesperidin and apigenin were efficiently separated by the chromatographic method with a standard error of 4% and showed retention times of 7.073 min, 11.517 min, 12.333 min and 17.497 min, respectively (Figure 3A).
reference: 该色谱方法有效分离了芦丁、柚皮苷、橙皮苷和芹菜素，标准误为 4%。四者的保留时间依次为 7.073 min、11.517 min、12.333 min 和 17.497 min（图 3A）。

source: Citrus peel extracts were analyzed with HPLC (Supplementary Materials) and the UV-Vis spectrophotometer in scansion mode (200 nm < λ < 700 nm) before (Figure 4) and after (Figure 5) the colorimetric assay application.
reference: 在比色测定前（图 4）和测定后（图 5），用 HPLC（见补充材料）和扫描模式的紫外–可见分光光度计（200 nm < λ < 700 nm）分析柑橘果皮提取物。

source: Even considering the only standard molecules available as references, bergamot showed a concentration of flavonoids up to 0.8915 ± 0.0081 mg/mL and, in any case, represented the extract with the highest number of signals identified (28 peaks).
reference: 即使只考虑可用作参照的标准分子，香柠檬（bergamot）的黄酮浓度仍高达 0.8915 ± 0.0081 mg/mL。无论如何，它也是已识别信号最多的提取物（28 个峰）。

source: RT = retention time; SD = standard deviation.
reference: RT 表示保留时间，SD 表示标准差。

source: A₀ is the absorbance of the negative control and A₁ is the absorbance of the extracts/standards.

facts.source: A₀ is the absorbance of the negative control
facts.zh: A₀ 是阴性对照的吸光度

facts.source: A₁ is the absorbance of the extracts/standards
facts.zh: A₁ 是提取物或标准品的吸光度

reference: A₀ 是阴性对照的吸光度，A₁ 是提取物或标准品的吸光度。

source: All experiments were conducted in triplicate. Data are presented as means of three independent experiments ± standard deviation, when applicable.
reference: 所有实验均重复三次。在适用情况下，数据以三次独立实验的均值 ± 标准差表示。

source: This approach, as underlined by Sisa and his collaborators, would also exclude different flavonoids from being quantified because of their aromatic rings which contain carbonyl chromophores absorbing at λ~350 nm [18].

facts.source: exclude different flavonoids from being quantified
facts.zh: 使一些黄酮无法被定量

reference: 正如 Sisa 及其合作者强调的那样，这种方法也会使一些黄酮无法被定量，因为它们的芳环中含有在 λ 约 350 nm 处吸收的羰基发色团 [18]。

source: The nitrite-aluminum assay led to a shift in this signal due to the nitrite-mediated oxidation of carbonyl groups (Figure 2).

facts.zh: 使这一信号发生了位移

terms.zh: 亚硝酸盐介导的羰基氧化

reference: 在亚硝酸盐–铝测定中，亚硝酸盐介导的羰基氧化使这一信号发生了位移（图 2）。

source:
Accurate real-time gait event detection is the basis for the development of new gait rehabil-
itation techniques, especially when utilizing robotics or virtual reality (VR).
reference: 准确地实时识别步态事件是开发新型步态康复技术的基础，在应用机器人或虚拟现实（VR）技术时尤其如此。

source: Gait analysis is an essential tool of modern physical medicine and rehabilitation. To enable comparisons between walking trials and among different individuals, gait is segmented into gait cycles.
reference: 步态分析是现代物理医学与康复医学的重要工具。为了比较多次步行试验或不同个体的表现，研究者将步态划分为若干步态周期。

source: Recent advancements in wearable technologies, such as inertial measurement units (IMUs) and shoe insoles with embedded force-sensing resistors, have provided reliable and affordable means for gait analysis.
reference: 近年来可穿戴技术取得进展，例如惯性测量单元（IMU）和嵌入力敏电阻的鞋垫，为步态分析提供了可靠且价格可负担的手段。

source: A single IMU is already embedded in any commercially available VR HMD. We propose using this sensor to perform real-time gait analysis.
reference: 市售虚拟现实头戴式显示器都已内置一个惯性测量单元（IMU）。我们提出利用这个传感器进行实时步态分析。

source:
We used the mediolateral component of the linear acceleration of the head as the driv-
ing signal for the pool of AFOs.

facts.zh: 作为自适应频率振荡器（AFO）组的驱动信号

reference: 我们使用头部线加速度的内外侧方向分量作为自适应频率振荡器（AFO）组的驱动信号。

source: A pool of n=4 AFOs was created, following Equations (1)–(6). The initial conditions and tuning gains for the oscillators, shown in Table 1, were chosen in such a way that the fundamental frequency of the pool would rapidly converge toward the cadence of gait (within approximately seven strides).
reference: 按照式（1）至（6）建立由 4 个自适应频率振荡器（AFO）组成的振荡器组。表 1 所列的初始条件和增益参数使振荡器组的基频能在约七个跨步周期内快速收敛到步频。

source: Initial conditions and tuning gains of the pool of adaptive frequency oscillators.
reference: 自适应频率振荡器组的初始条件和增益参数。

source: An example of a 6 s sliding window showing the driving signal and the estimation of a representative subject during the slow walking trial.
reference: 慢速步行试验中，一位代表性受试者的 6 s 滑动时间窗示例，展示驱动信号及其估计值。

source: We investigated whether our method performed differently (the error in the HS detection was the dependent variable) based on walking speed (either slow or fast; Factor A), the individual subject’s walking pattern (seven subjects; Factor B), or the interaction between the two using two-way ANOVA.
reference: 我们采用双因素方差分析，检验该方法的表现（因变量为足跟着地事件的检测误差）是否因步速（慢或快，因素 A）、个体步态模式（七名受试者，因素 B）或二者的交互作用而异。

source: Error distributions of HS detection in slow and fast trials are presented as histograms in Figure 3. Since gaits were symmetric, both errors at left and right HSs are shown in the same histogram.
reference: 图 3 用直方图展示慢速和快速试验中足跟着地（HS）检测误差的分布。由于步态对称，同一直方图同时显示了左、右足跟着地的误差。

source: Error distributions of heel strike gait event detection in slow (0.6 m/s) and fast (1.2 m/s) walking trials; 100 steps per participant per trial (50 right and 50 left HSs).

facts.zh: 每次试验中每位参与者走 100 步
左、右足跟着地各 50 次

reference: 慢速（0.6 m/s）和快速（1.2 m/s）步行试验中足跟着地事件检测误差的分布。每次试验中每位参与者走 100 步，其中左、右足跟着地各 50 次。

source: During asymmetric trials, the peak-detection algorithm for the contemporaneous synchronization of AFO phase with the gait cycle failed.
reference: 在非对称步态试验中，用于使自适应频率振荡器（AFO）相位与步态周期实时同步的峰值检测算法失效。

source: During normal symmetric walking, our AFO-based algorithm detected HS events in real time with good average accuracy compared to an offline CoP-based peak detection (used as the golden standard in this validation experiment), approximately within 1% of the gait cycle, and with moderate precision (standard deviation up to 7%).
reference: 在正常对称步行时，以离线的压力中心（CoP）峰值检测作为本次验证的金标准，基于 AFO 的算法能实时检测足跟着地事件，平均准确度较好，误差约在步态周期的 1% 以内，精密度中等（标准差最高为 7%）。

source: Our algorithm, however, has no such inherent delay. The errors in our algorithm originate mostly from the fact that our assumption of periodicity is violated.
reference: 不过，我们的算法没有这种固有延迟。算法误差主要源于实际步态不满足周期性假设。

source: While this paper shows that real-time gait event detection using a single head-mounted IMU is possible, we do not foresee our approach being implemented outside the fields of VR and AR. For higher accuracy, and when dealing with asymmetric gait, other sensor placements should be used.

facts.zh: 单个头戴式惯性测量单元

facts.source: outside the fields of VR and AR
facts.zh: 限于虚拟现实（VR）和增强现实（AR）

reference: 本文表明，单个头戴式惯性测量单元（IMU）可以实时检测步态事件，不过作者预计这种方法的应用将限于虚拟现实（VR）和增强现实（AR）。对精度要求更高或需要分析非对称步态时，宜将传感器置于其他部位。

source:
Poly(Ethylene Terephthalate) (PET) is one of the most used polymers for packaging applica-
tions.

facts.zh: 使用最广泛的聚合物之一

terms.zh: 聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯

reference: 聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）是包装领域使用最广泛的聚合物之一。

source: Two main processes are applied to recycle PET: chemical recycling and mechanical recycling [2,10]. Chemical recycling requires retrieving PET base monomers and purifying them.
reference: PET 回收主要采用化学回收和机械回收两种工艺 [2,10]。化学回收需要回收并纯化构成 PET 的单体。

source: Three types of PET are used: virgin PET (vPET), recycled PET (100rPET), and a blend of recycled material with virgin (50rPET) at 50/50%.
reference: 研究使用三种 PET，即原生 PET（vPET）、再生 PET（100rPET）以及再生料和原生料各占 50% 的共混料（50rPET）。

source: The Melt Flow Index or Rate (MFI or MFR) is an industrial parameter related to the viscosity of a molten polymer. MFI allows one to define the grade of a polymer (injection- or extrusion-grade).

facts.zh: 与聚合物熔体黏度有关

reference: 熔体流动指数或熔体流动速率（MFI 或 MFR）是与聚合物熔体黏度有关的工业参数。根据 MFI 可划分聚合物的加工等级，如注塑级或挤出级。

source: Figure 1 displays the heating and cooling steps applied for DSC analysis.
reference: 图 1 展示了差示扫描量热（DSC）分析所用的升温和降温步骤。

source: A heating ramp of 10 °C/min up to a temperature of 290 °C was first applied. After a holding step at 290 °C for one minute, a cooling step with a ramp of 10 °C/min to reach 30 °C was performed.
reference: 先以 10 °C/min 的速率升温至 290 °C，在 290 °C 保温 1 min 后，以 10 °C/min 的速率降温至 30 °C。

source: The long period L was calculated using the diffraction Bragg’s law (Equation (4)).
reference: 长周期 L 根据布拉格衍射定律计算，见式（4）。

source: DSC curves of semi-crystalline preforms for vPET, 50rPET, and 100rPET, heated from 30 °C to 290 °C at a heating rate of 10 °C/min for the second heating step after cooling from 290 °C to 30 °C at a cooling rate of −10 °C/min. Thermograms are vertically shifted.
reference: vPET、50rPET 和 100rPET 半结晶预制坯在第二次升温过程中的 DSC 曲线。样品先以 −10 °C/min 从 290 °C 冷却至 30 °C，再以 10 °C/min 从 30 °C 升温至 290 °C。为便于显示，热谱曲线沿纵向作了平移。

source: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) images of vPET with topography (a), indentation (b), contact modulus (c), and histogram of elastic moduli (d) at room temperature.
reference: 室温下 vPET 的原子力显微镜（AFM）图像显示表面形貌（a）、压入深度（b）、接触模量（c）和弹性模量直方图（d）。

source: Storage modulus (E′) as a function of temperature for vPET, 50rPET, and 100rPET measured by DMA, in tensile mode, at a frequency of 1 Hz and a heating rate of 2 °C/min.
reference: 采用动态力学分析（DMA），在拉伸模式、频率 1 Hz、升温速率 2 °C/min 的条件下测得 vPET、50rPET 和 100rPET 的储能模量（E′）随温度变化的曲线。

source: According to Figure 13, the area under Tan δ peak is also lower in the case of rPET which proves that the amorphous phase of 100rPET presents less molecular mobility. The presence of more crystalline regions, as suggested by DSC analysis, is constraining the amorphous phase.
reference: 根据图 13，再生 PET 的 Tan δ 峰面积也较小，作者据此认为 100rPET 非晶相中的分子运动能力较低。DSC 分析提示，较多的晶区对非晶相形成了约束。

source: This last approach tends to highlight the fact that no significant differences in the mechanical behaviour at the macroscopic scale can be seen between the three polymers.
reference: 后一种方法提示，在宏观尺度上，这三种聚合物的力学行为没有显著差异。

source: AFM, DMA, and uniaxial tensile test modulus values for vPET, 50rPET, and 100rPET at room temperature.
reference: 室温下用原子力显微镜（AFM）、动态力学分析（DMA）和单轴拉伸试验测得的 vPET、50rPET 和 100rPET 的模量值。

source: It is demonstrated that recycled PET (100rPET) presents lower molecular weight compared to virgin PET (vPET), while the Polydispersity Index remains equivalent.

facts.source: lower molecular weight compared to virgin PET

reference: 再生 PET（100rPET）的分子量低于原生 PET（vPET），而二者的多分散指数相当。

source:
The impact of these differences of crystalline morphologies on local mechanical be-
haviour was then characterised by AFM. Modulus analysis did not show signiﬁcant dif-
ferences between vPET and rPET.

facts.zh: 未显示原生 PET（vPET）与再生 PET（rPET）之间存在显著差异

reference: 随后采用原子力显微镜（AFM）表征这些晶体形貌差异对局部力学行为的影响。模量分析未显示原生 PET（vPET）与再生 PET（rPET）之间存在显著差异。

source: We performed multivariate logistic regression analysis to assess the relationship between sleep duration and risk of anemia after adjusting for covariates including age, gender, family income level, education level, physical activity, cigarette smoking, and alcohol usage.

facts.source: relationship between sleep duration and risk of anemia
facts.zh: 睡眠时长与贫血风险的关系

reference: 我们采用多变量 logistic 回归分析，在调整年龄、性别、家庭收入水平、教育程度、体力活动、吸烟和饮酒等协变量后，评估睡眠时长与贫血风险的关系。

source: Also, sleep duration of ≥9 h was related to lower risk of anemia in most premenopausal women after adjusting for covariates (odds ratio = 0.61; 95% confidence interval = 0.38–0.96, sleep duration of 6 h ~ < 8 h as the reference group).
reference: 调整协变量后，大多数绝经前女性中，每天睡眠 ≥9 h 与较低的贫血风险相关（比值比为 0.61，95% 置信区间为 0.38–0.96，参照组为睡眠 6 至不足 8 h 者）。

source: Postmenopausal women with sleep durations of ≥9 h had a significantly higher risk of anemia (odds ratio =2.02; 95% confidence interval =1.33–3.08) without adjusting for covariates. However, the associations became statistically insignificant after adjusting for age and covariates in both men and postmenopausal women.

facts.zh: 不再具有统计学显著性

reference: 未调整协变量时，睡眠 ≥9 h 的绝经后女性贫血风险显著较高（比值比为 2.02，95% 置信区间为 1.33–3.08）。然而，调整年龄和其他协变量后，男性和绝经后女性中的相关性均不再具有统计学显著性。

source: Anemia is highly prevalent in older individuals and has been linked to cardiovascular diseases, mortality, poor physical functionality, and disability [1,2,3].
reference: 老年人贫血患病率高，且贫血与心血管疾病、死亡、身体功能较差和残疾相关 [1,2,3]。

source: The data for our study were acquired from the seventh KNHANES (2016–2017). This survey is a nationally representative study of all ages and is designed to collect annual national data using stratified, multistage probability sampling to select household units.
reference: 本研究采用第七次韩国国民健康与营养调查（KNHANES，2016–2017 年）的数据。这项覆盖各年龄层、具有全国代表性的调查采用分层多阶段概率抽样选取家庭，按年收集全国数据。

source:
Among a total of 21,236 subjects (Figure 1), 16,277 completed the 2016–2017 KN-
HANES assessments, with an average response rate of 76.6%.
reference: 在 21,236 名调查对象中（图 1），16,277 人完成了 2016–2017 年的 KNHANES 评估，平均应答率为 76.6%。

source:
Responses were catego-
rized into five groups: <5 h, 5 h ~ <6 h, 6 h ~ <8 h, 8 h ~ <9 h, and ≥9 h per day , according 
to the mean sleep duration of 419 min (6.98 h) for the entire population.
reference: 根据全人群平均睡眠时长 419 min（6.98 h），将每日睡眠时长的回答分为五组，依次为 <5 h、5 至不足 6 h、6 至不足 8 h、8 至不足 9 h 和 ≥9 h。

source: Characteristics of the study population were analyzed using either a weighted chi-square test for categorical variables and a weighted one-way analysis of variance for continuous variables with Tukey or Bonferroni post hoc adjustment.
reference: 分析研究人群特征时，分类变量采用加权卡方检验，连续变量采用加权单因素方差分析，并采用 Tukey 或 Bonferroni 法进行事后校正。

source: The percentages of subjects who reported sleeping for <5 h, 5 h ~ <6 h, 6 h ~ <8 h, 8 h ~ <9 h, and ≥9 h per day were 4.4%, 10.1%, 56.7%, 19.5%, and 9.3%, respectively.
reference: 自报每日睡眠时长分别为 <5 h、5 至不足 6 h、6 至不足 8 h、8 至不足 9 h 和 ≥9 h 的受试者，依次占 4.4%、10.1%、56.7%、19.5% 和 9.3%。

source: Among the 11,131 subjects, 1001 (8.99%) had anemia (Table 2). The mean age of subjects with anemia was 51.55 ± 0.70 years old, and 20.0% were men.
reference: 11,131 名受试者中，1001 人（8.99%）患有贫血（表 2）。贫血受试者的平均年龄为 51.55 ± 0.70 岁，其中男性占 20.0%。

source: Compared with 6- <8-h sleep duration, self-reported sleep duration of greater or equal to 9 h was significantly associated with a higher risk of anemia in men (odds ratio = 2.48; 95% confidence interval = 1.63–3.81), without adjustments. However, the significance disappeared in the model adjusted for age and covariates.
reference: 未作调整时，与自报睡眠时长 6 至不足 8 h 的男性相比，自报睡眠 ≥9 h 与较高的贫血风险显著相关（比值比为 2.48，95% 置信区间为 1.63–3.81）。在调整年龄和其他协变量的模型中，该关联不再显著。

source: In the present study, we observed associations between sleep duration and anemia in the Korean population, based on a dataset drawn from the KNHANES in 2016 and 2017.

facts.zh: 观察到韩国人群的睡眠时长与贫血有关

reference: 本研究基于 2016 年和 2017 年 KNHANES 数据，观察到韩国人群的睡眠时长与贫血有关。

source: In the present study, we did not find a robust association between self-reported sleep duration and risk of anemia in both sexes (Table 3).

facts.source: did not find a robust association

reference: 本研究在男性和女性中均未发现自报睡眠时长与贫血风险之间存在稳健的关联（表 3）。

source: Because we used cross-sectional data, it remains unclear whether short sleep duration acts as a risk factor or is a consequence of lower hemoglobin levels and anemia.

facts.source: a risk factor or is a consequence

reference: 由于使用横断面数据，尚不能确定睡眠时长较短是血红蛋白水平较低和贫血的危险因素，还是其后果。

source: First, because we used data obtained from KNHANES, a cross-sectional survey, this study design did not establish temporal precedence between many factors and anemia.

facts.zh: 许多因素与贫血发生之间

reference: 首先，由于采用横断面调查 KNHANES 的数据，这种研究设计无法确定许多因素与贫血发生之间的时间先后顺序。

source:
Normalization of RNA-seq data has been an active area of research since the problem
was first recognized a decade ago. Despite the active development of new normalizers,
their performance measures have been given little attention.

terms.zh: 评价这些方法性能的指标

reference: 自大约十年前 RNA-seq 数据归一化问题首次受到关注以来，这一直是一个活跃的研究领域。尽管新的归一化方法不断涌现，评价这些方法性能的指标却很少受到重视。

source:
Between-sample normalization has long been recognized as a critical step in processing
and analyzing RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) data.
reference: 样本间归一化早已被公认为处理和分析 RNA 测序（RNA-seq）数据的关键步骤。

source: In ground-truth based evaluation, one obtains a correctly normalized expression matrix and defines a means to quantify how close they can get to this ideal solution (Fig. 1).
reference: 在基于真实值的评价中，需要获得一个已正确归一化的表达矩阵，并规定一种方法来量化评价对象与这一理想解的接近程度（图 1）。

source: A normalization method may produce normalized counts in one step, or first identify the set of references which is then used for scaling the read count matrix.
reference: 一种归一化方法可以一步得到归一化计数，也可以先确定一组参照基因，再用它们对测序读段计数矩阵进行缩放。

source: First, comparative studies heavily depended on DE detection, an analysis downstream of normalization.
reference: 首先，比较研究高度依赖差异表达（DE）检测，而这项分析位于归一化的下游。

source: In addressing these issues, we propose a ground-truth based measure called condition-number based deviation, or cdev, which measures the differences between two expression matrices.
reference: 为解决这些问题，作者提出一种依托真实值的指标，称为基于条件数的偏差（cdev），用来衡量两个表达矩阵之间的差异。

source: RNA-seq data were collected from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database based on the following criteria: having ERCC spike-ins added at a constant concentration across a sufficiently large number of samples. The list of studies where these assays were originally performed is available in Table 2.
reference: 我们从基因表达综合数据库（GEO）收集 RNA-seq 数据，入选条件是在足够多的样本中以恒定浓度加入 ERCC 外源对照。开展这些实验的原始研究列于表 2。

source: An expression profiling experiment of n genes on m samples typically results in an n × m matrix Y, the element yij of which captures the measurement of gene i in sample j. In RNA-seq, Y is the read count matrix output by the quantification process.

facts.zh: 基因 i 在样本 j 中

reference: 在 m 个样本中测量 n 个基因的表达，通常得到一个 n × m 的矩阵 Y，其中元素 yij 是基因 i 在样本 j 中的测量值。在 RNA-seq 中，Y 是定量过程输出的读段计数矩阵。

source: In simulations, the reference set R is composed of all non-DE genes, i.e., those with fold-change set to one. In real data sets, R contains the ERCC spike-ins detected at sufficiently high number of read counts, that is, at least t reads in every sample.

facts.source: at least t reads in every sample
facts.zh: 在每个样本中都至少有 t 个读段

reference: 在模拟中，参照集合 R 由所有非差异表达基因构成，即表达倍数变化设为 1 的基因。在真实数据集中，R 包含读段计数足够高的 ERCC 外源对照，即在每个样本中都至少有 t 个读段。

source: One should note that, cdev is not symmetric, i.e., cdev(X, A) ≠ cdev(A, X) for generally given matrices X and A. However, when the transformation from X to A involves only column-scaling, we have cdev(X, A) = cdev(A, X).
reference: 应注意，cdev 通常不对称。对于一般的矩阵 X 和 A，cdev(X, A) ≠ cdev(A, X)。但如果从 X 到 A 的变换只涉及逐列缩放，则 cdev(X, A) = cdev(A, X)。

source: Differential expression (DE) analysis was used as a downstream indicator of normalization quality.
reference: 研究以差异表达（DE）分析作为评价归一化质量的下游指标。

source: Relationship between cdev and fold-change MSE in simulation, at varying fraction of DE genes.

alternatives: 不同差异表达（DE）基因比例

terms.zh: 表达倍数变化均方误差

reference: 在模拟数据中，不同差异表达（DE）基因比例下，cdev 与表达倍数变化均方误差（MSE）之间的关系。

source: (A) Performance of various normalizers. (B, C) DE detection performance as measured by false positive rate (FPR) and area under the ROC curve (AUC).
reference: （A）不同归一化方法的表现。（B、C）用假阳性率（FPR）和 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）评价差异表达检测的表现。

source: Real data sets are more challenging, for none of the normalizers could stabilize the true references properly (Fig. S3). Figure 8 shows such results on the Rat Bodymap data sets as an example.

facts.zh: 各种归一化方法都未能

reference: 真实数据集的难度更大，因为各种归一化方法都未能适当地稳定真实参照的表达（补充图 S3）。图 8 以大鼠 Bodymap 数据集为例展示了这一结果。

source: Once a ground truth is defined, performance can be measured, conveniently and objectively, by a similarity (or dissimilarity) measure. Although MSE is an intuitive and easy-to-compute metric, the definition of fold-change MSE on more than two conditions becomes overly cumbersome.
reference: 一旦确定真实值，就可以用相似性或相异性指标方便、客观地评价性能。尽管均方误差（MSE）直观且易算，但当实验条件超过两种时，定义表达倍数变化的 MSE 就过于繁琐。
